# This repository does not accept contributions

No pull requests, no issues. Not because the work is unwelcome, but because there is nothing here to
edit by hand:

- Every number in `results/`, in `data/benchmark.json`, in the README table and in the PNGs is
  **generated** by a private runner from blind-judged verdicts. A hand edit would be overwritten on
  the next wave, and worse, it would break the one promise the bench makes: no figure is typed.
- The answer keys, the seeded repositories and the per-model diffs are withheld, so a run cannot be
  reproduced or re-scored from the outside, and a change to a score cannot be reviewed here.
- Issues, wiki, projects and discussions are switched off. Pull requests cannot be switched off on
  GitHub, so a workflow closes them automatically with a link to this file.

**If a number here disagrees with a receipt, or with a post, I want to know.** If a model is missing
from the board, tell me which model, which first-party CLI it ships with and which serving path.
Reach me on X ([@PawelHuryn](https://x.com/PawelHuryn)) or LinkedIn
([pawel-huryn](https://www.linkedin.com/in/pawel-huryn)).

Everything here is MIT: fork it, quote it, build on it. A link back is appreciated.
